text: Monday was the first real test after Wall Street's brutal week.
The S&P 500 rose one point four percent. The Nasdaq rose two point one percent. And the Dow gained 350 points.
A relief rally. But one green day does not end a correction.
Nvidia rose four point two percent, after last week's report about an SEC review of its accounting.
Zoom out: the S&P 500 is still about ten percent below its October record.
Next up: Dell's earnings tomorrow, and Wednesday's inflation data.
One day is not a trend. Long-term investors watch the direction, not the noise.
Your call: is the worst behind us, or still ahead? Comment BEHIND or AHEAD.
